notes.title: DEMO v419 is now LIVE
notes.notes:
Version 418 is now live for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3723490/Sister_of_a_Dragon__DEMO/]DEMO[/url] of Sister of a Dragon.

[h3][b]DETAILED VIEW OF CREATURES & CHARACTERS[/b][/h3]

You can now access the details of the selected opponent – in player party as well as among the opponents – by clicking on the [b](i)[/b] button next to each portrait, to see:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/ba5b287632934cfa44a80eb78f08506d0ec41d54.jpg[/img]
For opponents –
[list][*]tokens produced, and their cost in AP
[*]HP and AP stats
[*]Immunities/Vulnerabilities
[*]Conditions
[*]A more detailed visual of the creature[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/2bf298b69569b3bdd05ff673f9fc856d36ca1976.jpg[/img]
And for the player characters:
[list][*]A more detailed visual of the character
[*]Immunities/Vulnerabilities
[*]Conditions
[*]HP and AP stats[/list]
Thanks to ːmagic_sparklesː [b]Griffin[/b] and other players, who asked for more consistency in accessing this information.

[h3][b]END TURN BUTTON[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/f77375aa6bde1fc1d35e8e47958cecdcbe37b1e9.jpg[/img]
Based on user feedback, we updated the "end turn" button:
[list][*]it got bigger
[*]it now displays text on it, rather than the icon
[*]it moved to the bottom right corner[/list]
Next to this button you will also find an updated toggle for "detailed view" during the resolution phase, and a new visual of the button that calls up the in-game menu/settings.

[h3][b]TURN PANEL & ACTION POINTS[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/d2d3bd1b056cf5ac0987d11e7c2ddb0186dd95bd.jpg[/img]
The turn panel at the top got updated. Also, AP are now no longer shown as a bar, but are displayed as separate dots.

[h3][b]ROUNDING RULES[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/e9170f72209b2b2a8d053b10223d8fec77b1f185.jpg[/img]
A few people asked about the rounding rules (we round down anything below 0.50, and round up 0.50 and above). We created a new line of text, that is now displayed at the bottom of the token interaction table, to make it extra clear.

[h3][b]LEVEL DOWN / LEVEL UP BAR FOR TOKENS[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/f479b2aaf1bbd5873acab11bf3540ac639d0d357.jpg[/img]
In token tooltips, we used to show 2 progress bars that were the color of AP, and that said "current power" and "base power". Well, these are now upgraded to the versions that actually show the current values on the bars themselves. These demonstrate when the token levels down or levels up.

That's it for today, and we're off to continue working on the Story Mode.

[Team CO]

notes.title: DEMO 1.0 is now available!
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

The day has come, and we're so happy about it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3723490/Sister_of_a_Dragon__DEMO/

[h2][b]DEMO 1.0[/b][/h2]

DEMO 1.0 of Sister of a Dragon is now available on Steam in 10 languages. The game is developed by Charlie Oscar ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/369990/Gremlins_Inc/]Gremlins, Inc.[/url]) and Nikita Kulaga ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/599140/Graveyard_Keeper/]Graveyard Keeper[/url]).

[h3][b]10 LANGUAGES[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/89a288ceae90876e6b477724b608f1dd3232e517.jpg[/img]
[*]Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/c08a15a1e52cfdf78cc01826f6191eb5743062e2.jpg[/img]
[*]Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/bfc3250bb49fc9e24d511380d1bf4a586a8d3414.jpg[/img]
[*]German, French, Spanish (EU)

Some of these languages are still being updated. If you spot a typo, or something that's unclear – please let us know here on Steam Forums.

We will adjust the list of supported languages based on the actual demand, between now and when we'll be ready to release DEMO 2.0 with the Story Mode.

[h3][b]CURRENT SCOPE[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/8479642aff1f34c9d62bcc0b4f448884f906a9f0.jpg[/img]
The demo features one aspect of the game: turn-based battles. 

It contains 39 encounters across 13 challenges. 

The first players to earn 499/499 stars achieved this within 9-12 hours of playing.

[h2][b]UPDATES[/b][/h2]

Sister of a Dragon is in production, with regular updates.

[h3][b]WEEKLY UPDATES[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/2927d539e9595b78ba823478086a8768e3a232e2.jpg[/img]
The demo releases in version 416. 

We continue to update it, typically once a week. 

At the moment, we focus on the texts, the sound effects, and on the user interface.

[h3][b]STEAM NEXT FEST[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/c110e944d3c62465585cd3e8e463e79c755ed666.jpg[/img]
The demo participates in Steam Next Fest in June.

Once the Fest wraps, the demo will remain available (and will continue to be updated).

[h2][b]WHAT'S NEXT?[/b][/h2]

Turn-based battles are just a part of Sister of a Dragon.

[h3][b]STORY + BATTLES + PROGRESSION[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/566a9fe772fdec9fe20c991622676dd21426f0bd.jpg[/img]
The game is 1/3 battles (encounters with weapons, alchemy, crystals and spells), 1/3 story (stories, adventures, memories) and 1/3 progression (crafting, character development).

[h3][b]ROADMAP[/b][/h3]

DEMO 1.0 (available) is about the Challenge Mode.

DEMO 2.0 (end of the summer*) will introduce the Story Mode.

DEMO 3.0 (autumn*) will expand the Open World Mechanics. 

* – [i]an ambition, not a promise[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/830f270cd39f1fb3dda3a1b1a9f77fa5b2b1a87b.jpg[/img]
This game is our passion project. Stick around, and join us on this journey – as we add the story, the crafting mechanic, and the portals that connect the two realms of Rund!

[Team CO]

notes.title: Welcome to Steam Playtest!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Steam Playtest for Sister of a Dragon, an upcoming game from Charlie Oscar (Gremlins, Inc.) and Nikita Kulaga (Graveyard Keeper) – thanks for stopping by, and giving the game a try!

Here's the basics:

[h3][b]TIMELINE[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/4e9c279beea1105e4a7955945993899d46483b15.jpg[/img]

The Playtest begins on May 22, and will run until May 29.

On May 29, we plan to switch it off, and open the Demo of the game.

Later on, Sister of a Dragon will participate in Steam Next Fest, which begins on June 9.

You should be able to keep the config file with your progress (score) between the different builds.


[h3][b]ACCESS[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/6ae6f34a9c257986e8ffbe6030334a7111ded1e3.jpg[/img]

We start with 400 players from 20 different countries, and will add more as the test progresses.


[h3][b]UPDATES[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/ed6880ada0e8713e92cc7b9b02fb83767bd40015.jpg[/img]

Throughout the Playtest, the build will be updated regularly.

You will find the release notes here on Steam, in the announcement section.


[h3][b]FEEDBACK[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/90350acc29e63ed93022b14e94013aaddc61dd4c.jpg[/img]

Steam Forums work great.

You can also stop by our Discord server (but forums work better, as it allows others to find information quickly, and thus helps the community).

In the game, from the encounter mode, you can call up the in-game menu (a button in the lower right corner) and choose the option "Report a bug" directly form there, which will send us the error log as well.


[h3][b]LANGUAGES[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/29c6a3990aa4ec08caac53a066c355c956e74d03.jpg[/img]

At launch, these languages are complete:

[*]English
[*]Russian

These languages are in the process of translation, and will be updated in a few days:

[*]Japanese
[*]Simplified Chinese

The tags that have not yet been translated into these languages, will be displayed in English.

And these languages just got started, and will arrive, more likely, only in time for the Demo:

[*]Korean
[*]German
[*]French
[*]Italian
[*]Spanish (EU)
[*]Brazilian Portuguese

We do not plan any other languages at the moment, but will revisit the list after the Next Fest.


[h3][b]WHAT'S IN THE FUTURE?[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/271feff17659897d6994dacebdd2fa0566af0c5d.jpg[/img]

This Playtest features the Challenge Mode of the game.

Once we the Next Fest wraps, we will continue with the production of the Story Mode, which will be included in the demo once it's finished. The Story Mode will contain the part of the game from the moment Kaira wakes up in her house, and to her (temporary) parting with Nasuto in the Dark Forest.

We will be happy to have you along for this journey. 

Thanks for coming, and good luck with beating the challenges!

[Team CO]

notes.title: 24 hours from Playtest
notes.notes:
We're 24 hours form opening the Playtest, as we aim to finish the last missing piece of the puzzle today. At first, we will onboard players from Japan, USA, and Russia/Ukraine. We will include players from China/HK in a few days, after we integrate the Simplified Chinese translations – sorry about that wait!

notes.title: UPDATES 10-11-12/05/2025
UPDATE 06/05/2025
notes.notes:
As we get closer to opening the Playtest, we upgrade the weekly notes from "patch notes" to "regular updates" to make sure it won't be lost on those who participate in the test.

The current status:

* We have submitted the Playtest build for the pre-release review, and expect to pass it within a week or so (unless we run into some specific issue)

* We opened the sign-ups to the Playtest, and currently have a bit over 200 players in the list there (top countries: Russia, China, USA, Poland, Japan)

To join the Playtest, you need to hit the green button that says "Request access":

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/ad3adfe1d89043282ee4cb4dee0e7b93042f4477.jpg[/img]

It is so good to have this functionality, where we don't need to generate and distribute Steam keys on our own, and everything is automated! A huge progress since the times we ran the tests for our earlier projects.

And now, what's new in Tuesday's build –

[h3][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3]

[*]Updated tutorial:
[list]

[list]

[*]"Questionnaire" (we used to have it, but now simply won't have the time to read the responses[/list]
[*]Added collection of data when crashes occur
[*]Improved balance in the challenges from the Bonus Book

As of now, we aim to release the Playtest with 2 books (Prologue and Bonus), which have 10 and 3 challenges respectively. This comes to 39 encounters between the two, unlockable through progression.

notes.title: ADDICTED TO MAGIC
notes.notes:
[h3][b]The dangers of magic[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/022d369234111167d508eb5a243319a7092a2a80.jpg[/img]
Kaira is a mage, and magic is the most dangerous activity in the world of Rund.

In the human lands, mages elicit fear and hate among the commoners. Some are lynched by angry mobs, some are tortured to death in the dungeons of the Inquisition…

However, the biggest enemy of any mage is different – it’s their own self, for the majority of mages die when they lose control over their own power. 

[h3][b]From curiosity to addiction[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/2874f54c78396512a4e3af02b0971156d9b5bc44.jpg[/img]

Many humans and non-humans in Rund have a basic predisposition to magic, which is like the ability to anticipate a change in the weather: something vague, something like an intuition.

A few have a real talent for magic – a talent that remains dormant until and unless its owner receives proper training. Still, even with training, there’s a long way to the level that allows a person to cast spells. 

At the core of any spellcasting are magic crystals from which mages draw energy so that a young sorcerer may harness the power comparable to that of an advanced weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/fe3d182d1ae763ff2b18c3ccbd2aa3a540de0ba2.png[/img]

Such crystals are extremely rare – and this is fortunate, as otherwise there would be much ruin and tragedy… Why, you ask?

Because when a young mage gets a chance to handle magic energy for the first time, there's nothing in the world that compares with the delight and ecstasy of using the crystals.

For most people, it proves impossible to resist the temptation of doing more magic again, and again, and again – once you have tasted the power of sorcery, what started as a curiosity becomes an addiction. 

Only a few mages have enough willpower to control their engagement with this force. For most, it takes the Suppressive Potion to diminish the mad thirst for more. 

As to the rest of the mages… they become an easy prey for the distortion.


[h3][b]Destroyed by distortion[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/21c0a9dea0a3cc8ceb43205e96c3084104f9dba1.jpg[/img]

Each use of magic crystals and spells punches a new hole in the fabric of space. Such holes allow the distortion from the Phantom Realm to seep not only into the environment of the Free Realm (which is where humans and non-humans dwell), but also directly into the bodies of practicing mages.

Touched by distortion, mages experience a bout of euphoria, which leads them to seek and cast more powerful spells – until the distortion eventually takes over their whole bodies and minds.

A mage infected with the distortion becomes a threat to themselves and to others, including those that are closest to them.

Under the influence of the distortion, the mage’s mental state deteriorates – in the end, they go mad. The powerful streams of magic energy that they summon get out of control, which leads to the summoner’s death, as well as kills the innocents, and causes a terrible destruction of the land.

To prevent such tragedies, the Inquisition searches for mages throughout the human lands – to neutralize the threat before it explodes. As to the commoners… if they suspect someone of being a mage, they resort to stoning or drowning the suspect. And while the majority of the lynched may not even be mages, this is accepted by the Empire as a lesser evil, and a price worth paying.

notes.title: THE TWO REALMS OF RUND
notes.notes:
[h3][b]The Free Realm[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/7394ee82086e087c5b996a18c6dea984b3c149d0.jpg[/img]

Kaira lives in a world known as “Rund”. 

However, when people talk about Rund, they usually imply just a part of it – the so-called "Free Realm".
The Free Realm is large and diverse; it has old forests and deep lakes, snow-capped mountains, and boundless deserts. This realm is inhabited by both human and non-human races.

Traveling through the Free Realm, one comes across the rich and populous cities of the Empire, the majestic citadels of the Inquisition, and the ruins of the Legion's ancient fortresses. The villages of wildlings and the settlements of non-humans, hidden from the prying eyes, lie scattered in the Wild Lands.

The Free Realm has a sinister twin that most people prefer never to mention – the Phantom Realm.


[h3][b]The Phantom Realm[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/8b4df6716d42944866f2ec4c493304bb61758c6f.jpg[/img]

The Phantom Realm is a dark, frightening place, the stuff of the nightmares. 

It is untouched by sunlight or moonlight; there are no singing birds and no buzzing grasshoppers. In fact, it is exceedingly rare to meet a sentient being here because a long stay in the Phantom Realm is ruinous for one’s mind. 

Once upon a time, the Phantom Realm used to be a place of pilgrimage for a particular tribe of non-humans, Enigo. They communicated with the spirits of their ancestors in the sanctuaries known as the Memory Caves. These days, the Memory Caves have become the places of indescribable horror.
The Phantom Realm is full of distortion – a toxic substance of unknown nature. 

The distortion is everywhere in this realm: it's in the soil, in the plants, and even in the air. Spirits that live in the Phantom Realm are saturated with this substance as well – these terrible creatures are known as demons or phantoms. Legends say that their power knows no limit.

Fortunately, the demons of the Phantom Realm have no way of getting into the Free Realm: all the portals that once connected the realms have been closed for a long time – and the secret of traveling through them has been lost for good.


[h3][b]The distortion[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/7a82d601a21727f6317b600aa0b3ee2aaf47337b.jpg[/img]

Nevertheless, the inhabitants of the Free Realm have a reason to worry:

Thanks to the humans and the non-humans who use magic, plenty of holes appear in the barrier that separates the two realms, and it is through these holes that the distortion seeps into the Free Realm – infecting those who use magic, and the land itself.  

One of the core commitments of the great Empire – the cradle of human civilization, and the strongest state of the Free Realm – is to prevent the spread of the distortion. Which is why the imperial Inquisition hunts for mages, day and night.

notes.title: KAIRA FROM THE NORTHERN MARSHES
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Kaira?[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/6fc10f21726b0371c1fd7e365bff3c2eb13c95e7.png[/img]

The hero of our story, Kaira, was born in…

...hmm, the fact is – nobody knows where she was born, and who her parents were.

Though maybe somebody knows, but they just don't want to tell her?

When Kaira asks about her past, her older brother Sainar falls silent and frowns, and her uncle Nasuto changes the subject of the conversation. 

And when she asks aunt Mirza, her guardian, the aunt tells Kaira to put such stupid questions out of her head, and to get busy with the housework.

What Kaira knows for certain, though, is that she was just a baby when uncle Nasuto brought her to Green Shallows, this remote village in the marshes. Here, uncle Nasuto entrusted Kaira to the care of his old acquaintance, the village herbalist Mirza.

Ever since, her uncle has been regularly sending money to Mirza, so that Kaira’s needs are covered.

[h3][b]A controlling guardian[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/d4a9fa4a09fdb8d48adbf71da377273aef167f6c.png[/img]

Kaira can hardly stand her guardian Mirza, who is always grumpy and picky. 

Since her childhood, Kaira took care of the dozens – hundreds! – of chores, from weeding out the flowerbeds to sorting the petals of the medicinal flowers into sachets for sale at the market. 

Once Kaira grew up enough, Mirza also assigned her the concoction of simple healing tinctures. Kaira passionately hates doing all of that, which leads to regular quarrels between the child and her guardian.
These days, Kaira tries to catch her guardian's eye as little as possible; she even ran away from home on a couple of occasions, for several days at a time.

[h3][b]A caring uncle[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/c9607689d03657d3f1edf2f8e4dad8b1fc62d203.png[/img]

On the other hand, Kaira loves her uncle Nasuto very much. 

Even though he rarely visits her, she doesn't blame him: he is an important person in the Empire, one of the heads of the powerful Guild. Because of his busy schedule, it is only rarely that Nasuto has the luxury of taking a day off. 

At least he writes to Kaira regularly, and often sends his niece small gifts together with such letters.

[h3][b]A busy brother[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/86dda7a2f18186afbbaffd756f3dd169b22edc79.png[/img]

Kaira's older brother, the ever-absent Sainar, works for the Guild as well. 

Recently, Kaira is worried about him: it seems that something gnaws at Sainar. 

Lately, he has withdrawn into himself, and he has visited Kaira only a couple of times in the last year. He explained that by saying that the Guild sends him on very long expeditions into the Wild Lands, and these expeditions come one right after another.

He even missed Kaira’s birthday – which upset, and even offended, her.

[h3][b]The best friend[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/87cc4a950d11d25aab75aa3b6ffc647e3d9de6d5.png[/img]

Fortunately, there’re plenty of teenagers in the village, and Kaira made good friends with many of them. 
Together, they fish in local ponds, hunt small animals, sing songs around the campfire, dance to the sounds of reed pipes – and make out in the bushes, when nobody’s watching. Along with her friends, Kaira explored almost all of the Northern Marshes (except for the few places that the villagers consider cursed and off-limits, such as the cemeteries of non-humans).

However, Kaira’s best friend is not among this crowd of youngsters.

Her best friend is Becky – and she’s the person who is the closest to Kaira in the whole of the village.
Becky is a mutant, her parents have abandoned her soon after she was born. 

Not only that, but she became an outcast even in this village, which is a place that’s mostly inhabited by the outcasts anyway… The local mutants reject Becky because of her kind and gentle nature, and the rest of the villagers dislike her because of the stripes on her face – the stripes that clearly mark Becky as a mutant. And, let’s be honest, nobody likes mutants.

Some years ago, Kaira helped Becky fend off the local bullies – this is how they’ve met.

For Becky, Kaira is the only friend in the whole world. 

And for Kaira, Becky is someone who always has the time to listen to her ideas, and who – unlike Mirza – fully understands her. Together, they dream of the day when both of them will finally leave this boring village, and move into a big town to live their big lives.

Kaira never suspected that soon, her friendship with Becky would lead to a terrible tragedy…
